findings.finding: Catalan product: N=∏_{n=0}^{19}(C_{2^n})^{2^{19-n}}, C_m=(2m)!/((m+1)!m!). Compute v₂(N),v₅(N) via Legendre: v_p(C_m)=v_p((2m)!)-2v_p(m!)-v_p(m+1). Sum weighted by 2^{19-n}. k=min(v₂(N),v₅(N)). Output k mod 10⁵. Use Python for n=0..19.

Tournament = full binary tree of 2^20 leaves. At each node of size 2m, winners (size m) must satisfy w_i≤m+i−1 ⇒ Catalan C_m choices.  
Thus N=∏_{j=0}^{19}C_{2^j}^{2^{19‑j}}.  
v₂(C_{2^j})=1 (j≥1) ⇒ v₂(N)=2¹⁹−1=524 287.  
v₅(C_{2^j})=v₅((2^{j+1})!)-2v₅((2^j)!)-v₅(2^j+1). Compute for j=0…19, weight by 2^{19‑j}: Σ=121 818.  
k=min(v₂,v₅)=121 818; k mod 10⁵=21 818.   (Pitfall: ensure Catalan count, not pairings.)
